x: Du'aine Ladejo went out hard, as did the Welshman Iwan Thomas but Roger Black was in the form of his life and coming strongly off the bend he came through for a British Record 44.39 while Ladejo had to be content with 2nd in a personal (and Club) best of 44.66.

Iwan Thomas was a close third just ahead of Andrew Walcott who was showing a late season return to form. In the 10000m Jim Estall, fresh from holiday and claiming to be unfit, had a good tussle with former record holder Julian Goater and moved our point score along nicely.

A 45.5 clocking made him second fastest of the quartet but with top men Iwan Thomas and Mark Richardson taking a breather before the final, no-one had any complaints about the final selection on this occasion.
